name: hosts
description_en: 🔒 Consolidating and extending hosts files from several well-curated sources. Optionally pick extensions for porn, social media, and other categories.
readme_excerpt: > [!IMPORTANT] > Cloning this repository can take a long time! > You probably just want to start with the latest version, not its whole history since 2018. > Therefore you probably want to use git clone --depth 1 ... to save significant time. > [!NOTE] > With the exception of issues and PRs regarding changes to hosts/data/StevenBlack/hosts, all other issues regarding the content of the produced hosts files should be made with the appropriate data source that contributed the content in question.…
